> *"You cannot get through a single day without having an impact on the world around you. What you do makes a difference, and you have to decide what kind of difference you want to make."* — Jane Goodall

### About me

I am a ⟨Bio⟩ statistician with a keen interest in unravelling complex population processes—particularly within the field of health—through mathematical and statistical modelling.

**Statistical Interests:** Methodological interests include Bayesian statistics, multilevel modelling, survival analysis, stochastic processes, statistical learning, and causal inference.

**Application Areas:** Applications of statistical methods in demographic and epidemiological research, covering mortality patterns and trends, life expectancy, migration dynamics, population projections, economic and health inequalities, substance use patterns, environmental health, and infectious disease modelling.
